column1: # EXP-R2-224 first-round stage-01 Swiss-Prot context-information qualification,
# progen2-large and progen2-xlarge on the eight frozen EXP-R2-216 blocks.
# The eight blocks reproduce ProGen2-medium's frozen `swissprot_progen2_medium_f32`
# draw exactly: seeded permutation of the whole corpus at --cohort-draw-seed 20260728,
# pool 1000, --cohort-skip 7000k for k = 0..7, band 64-246, n 200, held-out unigram
# reference 4000, --seed 20260727. Cohort.digest hashes records only, so each cell's
# expect basename carries that block's medium digest: a cell that drew anything else
# writes a differently named file and is reported no-artifact rather than silently
# paired against a block it does not share. The digests were reproduced on the
# workstation from the same corpus before this manifest was written.
# float32, not the stage default, and not a preference. The medium blocks these two
# rungs are placed beside were produced at float32 because a bfloat16 instability was
# measured on that checkpoint, and they are reused rather than re-scored; a ladder
# scored at two precisions is partly a comparison of arithmetic. This is the
# EXP-R2-224 pre-data amendment's binding declaration for stage 01 into stage 41.
# ProteinGym and MegaScale are scored at bfloat16 by that same amendment and are not
# this manifest's cells.
# The two rungs do not take the same truncation flag, and the asymmetry is an
# interface fact rather than a choice. budget.truncation_curve refuses a live logit
# width above 1024 without logits_to_keep support, because the untrimmed path is a
# different unembedding kernel and would not reproduce a curve measured on the
# trimmed one. progen2-large emits 51200 columns and trips that guard; progen2-xlarge
# emits 32 and does not. panel_contract's cohort-item rules already carry exactly this
# rule for panel members -- "protein arms with vocabulary > 1024: the truncation curve
# is not computable on this transformers build, so --skip-truncation" -- and the two
# staged rungs are non-members that no bucket assigns, so it is applied here by hand.
# The first dispatch of this campaign omitted the flag and all three large cells in
# slot 1 refused at that guard with exit 1, having touched no card. Nothing else moves:
# the truncation curve is a reported diagnostic that 41_context_information_bootstrap.py
# never reads, and the identification rule is the displacement-corrected near-duplicate
# -group bootstrap over the sufficient-statistics sidecars, which is unaffected.
# Slots are homogeneous in rung so a slot barrier waits on like-sized cells, and the
# xlarge cells -- the ones that need no flag the freeze did not already imply -- run
# first. float32 weights are about 25.8 GB for xlarge and 11.1 GB for large, both
# comfortable on one 143 GB card, so no cell shards.
